scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,yellow "cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4321
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python -m venv venv && pip install -r requirements.txt
